Definition: from G4862 and G936; to be co-regent (figuratively):--reign with.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says if we suffer we shall also reign with Him, and then turns the word on the Corinthians with irony, that they already reign as kings without the apostles, and he wishes they truly did reign so that the apostles might reign with them. Reigning with Christ is a promise tied to suffering with Him, not a prize for getting ahead of Him.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the throne is reached through suffering with Christ, and I hold that any reigning that leaves Him and His people behind is no reigning at all.
